general.typography_note: Body, navigation, and product information use Instrument Sans. Display and section headings use Instrument Serif. Intention & authenticity uses Snell Roundhand.

labels.product_badges_info: Choose badge products once here. They show on the homepage, collection, recommendations, and product pages.
labels.show_free_shipping_bar_info: Shows progress toward your Shopify automatic discount (by item count or spend).
labels.offer_mode_info: Match this to your Shopify discount minimum (quantity of items, or purchase amount).
labels.offer_quantity_threshold_info: Same number as in Shopify Discounts → Minimum quantity of items (for example 2).
labels.offer_quantity_progress_info: Use __COUNT__ for how many more items are needed.
labels.free_shipping_threshold_info: Used only when unlock mode is Spend amount. Amount in store currency (for example 3000 for 3000 EGP).
labels.free_shipping_progress_info: Use __AMOUNT__ for the remaining amount. Used only in Spend amount mode.
labels.free_shipping_success_info: Fallback when unlocked. If Shopify already applied a discount, that discount title is shown instead.
labels.product_badges_section_info: Pick products below for this section. To show the same Limited / New / Sale / low-stock badges on product pages too, also set Theme settings → Product badges.
labels.badge_tag_info: Turn this on, then choose products below. Only those products show New in.
labels.badge_tag_optional_info: Optional fallback. Products with this Shopify Admin tag also show New in.
labels.new_products_info: Turn this on, then choose products below. Only those products show New in.
labels.new_products_picker_info: Select each product that should show New in.
labels.sale_tag_info: Turn this on, then choose products below. Only those products show Sale.
labels.sale_tag_optional_info: Optional fallback. Products with this Shopify Admin tag also show Sale.
labels.sale_products_info: Turn this on, then choose products below. Only those products show Sale.
labels.sale_products_picker_info: Select each product that should show Sale.
labels.limited_products_info: Turn this on, then choose products below. Only those products show the Limited Pieces tag.
labels.limited_products_picker_info: Select each product that should show Limited Pieces.
labels.limited_tag_optional_info: Optional fallback. Products with this Shopify Admin tag also show Limited Pieces.
labels.limited_tag_info: Turn this on, then choose products below. Only those products show the Limited Pieces tag.
labels.preorder_button_label_info: Replaces Add to basket when the product, or the selected size, is a pre-order.
labels.preorder_size_rules_info: One line per size: product-handle | size. Only that size uses the pre-order button. Example: the-allure-blazer-in-black | S/M
labels.preorder_note_info: Shown under the button when the selected product or size is a pre-order.
labels.preorder_products_info: Turn this on, then choose products below. Only those products show Pre-order.
labels.preorder_products_picker_info: Select each product that should show Pre-order.
labels.preorder_tag_optional_info: Optional fallback when no products are selected. Products with this Shopify Admin tag also show Pre-order.
labels.coming_soon_products_info: Turn this on, then choose products below. Only those products show Coming soon.
labels.coming_soon_products_picker_info: Select each product that should show Coming soon.
labels.coming_soon_tag_optional_info: Optional fallback when no products are selected. Products with this Shopify Admin tag also show Coming soon.
labels.coming_soon_section_products_info: Choose the products that appear in this Coming soon section.
labels.coming_soon_preorder_products_info: Shows a Pre-order tag at the bottom of the card. Add a product to show the tag, remove it to hide the tag.
labels.low_stock_products_info: Turn this on, then choose products below. Only those products can show the low stock warning when inventory is below the threshold.
labels.low_stock_products_picker_info: Select each product that should show the low stock warning.
labels.low_stock_label_info: Use __COUNT__ where the remaining quantity should appear.
labels.low_stock_threshold_info: Show the warning when tracked inventory is below this number (not equal).
labels.collection_info: Used when no products are selected above.
labels.image_fallback_info: Leave this empty to keep the current theme image. Choose an image to replace it.
labels.products_info: Choose the products for this row. Titles, prices, photos, and colors come from each product.
labels.favicon_info: Leave this empty to keep the Remelle icon. Choose an image here to replace it.
labels.heading: Heading
labels.name: Name
labels.information_text_info: This text is the same on every product. Leave it empty when Use product description is on.
labels.about_image_info: Choose the story photograph. The Remelle mark in the frame is part of the image.
labels.question: Question
labels.open_row_info: Leave off so the row starts closed. All expands start closed by default.
labels.cart_label_info: The cart count is added after this label automatically.
labels.page_heading_info: Leave empty to use the page title from Shopify admin.
labels.page_content_info: Leave empty to use the page content from Shopify admin.
labels.use_product_description_info: Shows the description from the product. The text above is used only when that product has no description.
labels.listing_heading_info: Leave this empty to use the collection name.
labels.hero_image_desktop_info: Used on desktop and tablets wider than 720px.
labels.hero_image_mobile_info: Used on mobile (up to 720px). Leave empty to fall back to the Desktop Image.
labels.hero_image_2_mobile_info: Mobile image for the second slide. Leave empty to use the Second Desktop Image.
labels.hero_image_2_info: Used when no Slide blocks are added. Prefer Slide blocks for more than two images.
labels.hero_slides_help: To add more hero images: click Add block → Hero image. Each block is one slide with Desktop Image and Mobile Image. You can add up to 12. Autoplay advances every 3 seconds.
labels.hero_fallback_help: Used only when no Hero image blocks are added. Prefer Add block → Hero image for 3 or more slides.
labels.hero_slide_copy_info: Optional. Leave blank to keep the section heading, text, and button.
